events.title: Next Fest kickoff: bring friends
events.summary: Next Fest is on. Hop into the demo with friends and help each other get a bathtub to space. Or shoot the engines out of each other's pockets, whichever happens first. The demo is free, shifts are 8 minutes, and it is built for 2 to 4 players. Mac and PC play together. Looking for people to play with? Find them on Discord: https://discord.gg/ErVPQKeEua Halfdan

events.title: New trailer, free demo, and a date: October 27
events.summary: The yard is open. There's a new trailer, the free demo is live, and Junkyard Astronauts launches on October 27. Free demo. Up to 90 minutes, 8-minute shifts, and enough scrap to get a rocket into space. The Moon is for the full game. Steam Next Fest, Oct 19-26. I'll be playing with people during the fest. If you want a match with the dev, join the Discord: https://discord.gg/ErVPQKeEua Launch, Oct 27. $5.99, 17% off for the first two weeks. Windows and Mac (Apple Silicon), online co-op for 1-4 p
